name: Intraday ADX momentum breakout (5m)
rationale: On a 5m clock a confirmed ADX trend plus a fresh positive short-return and a break to the top of the recent range is momentum ignition: slower intraday participants (funds rebalancing on 15m/1h clocks, TWAP algos) react late, so the first movers ride the delayed continuation. The other side is the liquidity provider who gets run over by a real directional order flow. Edge persists because reaction latency across timeframes is structural. Disconfirmer: exits when ADX collapses below the exit floor (the trend was a fake-out) before the stop.
catalyst: confirmed intraday trend breaking to a new range high
